summary: AnythingLLM is an all-in-one desktop and containerised application designed for interacting with language models. It includes built-in retrieval-augmented generation, automated agents, and support for the Model Context Protocol.
goodFor: It suits users wanting a self-hosted workspace to query private documents and run local AI workflows without relying on external cloud services.
watchOut: Running local embedding models and large language models requires significant hardware resources, particularly a capable GPU.
deployNotes: You will typically deploy this via Docker, ensuring persistent storage volumes are mounted for your document workspace data and vector database.
